Guess Where! repo

A tiny F-Droid repository hosting Guess Where!, a photo geography game built on free-licensed Wikimedia Commons imagery and OpenStreetMap maps.

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://eyoussef.github.io/guesswhere/repo
